source: roots_gen.jpg (GenerateImage root/flare sheet, colour-matched to trunk)
notes: angle>0 = clockwise on screen; pieces rotate about attach_px. Place a piece by putting its attach_px on socket_px (2048 canvas). Draw order: roots, trunk_flare, trunk, branches, canopy (or canopy_clump_1..4 instead of canopy). socket_px is authoritative; source_canvas_origin = socket_px - attach_px of the 0-degree variant (for rotated variants it is socket_px - attach_px of that variant, i.e. its top-left on the canvas). v3: branches are segment chains (segments/segments.json, merged here; kinds branch_base/branch_mid/branch_tip). 8 slots: branch_slot_N gives trunk socket_px + chain heading (angle). canopy_clump_N socket_px = default chain tip. bloom_px on branch_mid/branch_tip = flower points in piece pixels (6 per piece; base+mid1+mid_loop+mid2+mid3+tip = 30). Legacy single-piece branch_1..4 kept for reference. Root socket_px lie on trunk_flare.
